#!/usr/bin/python3
import re
st = open('/proc/self/status').read()
ign = int(re.search(r'SigIgn:\s*([0-9a-f]+)', st).group(1), 16)
blk = int(re.search(r'SigBlk:\s*([0-9a-f]+)', st).group(1), 16)
names = {1: 'HUP', 2: 'INT', 3: 'QUIT', 10: 'USR1', 12: 'USR2', 14: 'ALRM', 15: 'TERM'}
print('ignored:', ' '.join(n for s, n in sorted(names.items()) if ign >> (s - 1) & 1) or '-', 'blocked-any:', 'yes' if blk else 'no')
X

export FOO=leaked LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/nonexistent BASH_ENV=/nonexistent
echo "--- argv"
words=('' 'two words' '--dash' $'new\nline' "it's" '$HOME' '*' '"dq"' ' padded ' ';' '&&' 'back\slash')
want=$("$P/argv.sh" "${words[@]}")
got=$(doas -u alice "$P/argv.sh" "${words[@]}")

echo "--- descriptors"
exec 3< "$P/argv.sh" 4> "$P/fdout" 5<> "$P/fdrw" 9< "$P/argv.sh" 10< "$P/argv.sh" 99< "$P/argv.sh"
echo "control $("$P/fds.sh")"
echo "child $(doas -u alice "$P/fds.sh")"
exec 3<&- 4>&- 5>&- 9<&- 10<&- 99<&-
echo "--- signals"
trap '' INT TERM HUP QUIT USR1 USR2 ALRM
echo "control $("$P/sigs.py")"
echo "child $(doas -u alice "$P/sigs.py")"
trap - INT TERM HUP QUIT USR1 USR2 ALRM
echo "--- statuses"
doas -u alice /bin/bash -c 'exit 7'; echo "exit7 rc=$?"
doas -u alice /bin/bash -c 'kill -TERM $$'; echo "sigterm rc=$?"
doas -u alice /bin/bash -c 'kill -KILL $$'; echo "sigkill rc=$?"
doas -u alice /nonexistent/command 2> /dev/null; echo "enoent rc=$?"
doas -u alice /etc/passwd 2> /dev/null; echo "eacces rc=$?"
